Thanks for helping improve Verus!

Whenever possible and applicable, please include a 'minimal repro' in your issue. The ideal minimal repo is a complete, single-file program (including `use` and `verus! { ... }` boilerplate) with no dependencies. Also include any command line arguments that are necessary to reproduce the issue, and include the Verus version (from `verus --version`).

Sometimes a minimal repro might be impossible; this might be because the example requires multiple crates, or because it's too difficult to minimize the bug for whatever reason.  If you need to attach a large codebase to your issue, please consider using the `--record` feature to produce a zip file (containing a copy of your crate, along with relevant metadata such as Verus command line arguments), to attach to the issue to help us reproduce it. See https://github.com/verus-lang/verus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md for more details.

We also have some support for automatic minimization of issues. See https://github.com/verus-lang/verus/tree/main/source/tools/minimizers for more details.

For feature requests, please use the Discussions page (https://github.com/verus-lang/verus/discussions).  We suggest adding a comment if you can find a relevant discussion, but feel free to open a new discussion in the "Feature Requests" category (https://github.com/verus-lang/verus/discussions/categories/feature-requests).
